events.title: I originally started by making a comic shop simulator
events.summary: About a year and a half ago, Sort My Comics! wasn’t a sorting game at all. The original idea was to make a proper comic shop simulator. events.title: No artistic talent? Let's figure it out!
events.summary: For this game, I had way too many potential 2D visual assets for the covers. If I had the money, I would have loved to let 8 artists imagine their own superheroes and showcase them. events.title: I made my own cozy sorting game!
events.summary: Hello everyone! Allow me to introduce myself: I’m William. Usually, I’m mostly here to help indie devs and game creators release great, polished games with solid marketing, etc. But I’ve always been a failed creator who couldn’t finish his own personal projects.
